Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 16 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
